Military Police in Água Clara, Mato Grosso do Sul, received an anonymous tip on
4 November 2026 that a man was selling drugs using a white Volkswagen Gol in the
Jardim das Palmeiras neighbourhood. The driver fled when officers
approached but was stopped after a chase, and police found a portion of a
substance similar to cocaine in the car and portions of marijuana, a precision
scale, packaging material and money at the suspect's home.

A task force of Military Police and Civil Police then located two other suspects
in a snack bar and later found 59 tablets of a substance similar to marijuana
weighing about 54 kilograms. According to Edição MS, citing the Civil
Police, five suspects aged 30, 18, 20, 22 and 28 were arrested in the operation,
including two men aged 18 and 20 found at a second address used to store drugs.

The same account said police arrested a 22-year-old suspect with 500 grams of a
substance similar to marijuana and a precision scale, and a 28-year-old suspect
who had an outstanding arrest warrant for drug trafficking. All those
involved were taken to the Civil Police station in Água Clara for legal
procedures, and Edição MS reported that police seized about 54.64 kilograms of
marijuana and cocaine in total, along with a motorcycle, three precision scales,
three mobile phones, packaging material and about R$250 in cash.

Three Thai nationals were arrested at Bandaranaike International Airport in
Katunayake for allegedly attempting to smuggle hashish into Sri Lanka.
Police Narcotics Bureau officers arrested the suspects early on 15 October 2026
as they attempted to leave the airport. The three suspects, aged 22, 22 and
33, were reported to be drivers in Thailand.

They arrived at Katunayake Airport from Bangkok on Thai Airways flight TG-307 at
about 12.30 a.m. on 15 October 2026. Officers found 5.096 kilograms of
hashish concealed inside cosmetic product containers in the suspects’ three
pieces of luggage. Officials estimated the seized hashish was worth about
Rs. 51 million.

The suspects and the seized narcotics were scheduled to be produced before the
Negombo Magistrate’s Court on 15 October 2026.

substation, with the KC-HIDTA task force and the Taft Police Department,

facility. The sheriff’s office said the investigation remained active and
ongoing.
